description: Hourly Cursor Automation campaign window. Agent runs scripts/orchestrator-gate.mjs at step 0.
notes: Active for 1 day from campaign_start, every 30 min (*/30 * * * *). Then paused until campaign_start + active_days + pause_days. Set enabled:false to halt immediately. Set on_resume to 'new_campaign' to auto-start a fresh 1-day window after the pause.
